name: com.loopholetape/check-before-you-pay
title: Check before you pay
description: Before you pay a Bittensor subnet's entry fee, see what happened to the people who paid it.

tools.name: check_contest
tools.description: Call this before paying the registration fee of a Bittensor subnet. It returns, in plain sentences measured from the chain, what the fee is now, how many of the entries made 2 to 14 days ago are still in and what a typical one is paid a day today, how many days today's fee takes to come back at that pay, how the entries from two to four weeks ago ended up, who is paid today, and what the measurement cannot see.

tools.name: list_contests
tools.description: Call this when choosing which Bittensor subnet to enter. It returns one row for every subnet whose entry fee is $1 or more, with the fee now, how many new entries are still in, what a new entry is paid a day today, how many days the fee takes to come back at that pay, and how last month's entries ended up.

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Call this to see how a wallet has done on Bittensor entry fees. Give the coldkey, which is the SS58 address that pays the fees, and it returns every entry that wallet made in the last 30 days with the fee paid, what came back, the result and whether the entry is still being paid.

coldkey.description: The SS58 address of the wallet that pays the fees, about 48 characters starting with 5.
